sloka: कृत क्षणा अहम् भद्रम् ते गमनम् प्रति राघव ।वन वासस्य शूरस्य चर्या हि मम रोचते ॥२-२९-१५॥
transliteration: kṛta kṣaṇā aham bhadram te gamanam prati rāghava ।vana vāsasya śūrasya caryā hi mama rocate ॥2-29-15॥

translations.english: Since then I have been counting time for this forest life. It pleases me to follow my valiant hero as he lives in the forest. Rama, prosperity to you
